title: 第十七章 教学局第十八章 潜在威胁
content_zh:
虽然虚界中可以无限刷新人物状态，操控的角色永远都是满血满蓝，但是人的注意力集中力不是无限的。
玩家的状态自然会影响到操作。
12:34
王庆又重复了一次10胜1败，总要给点机会，目前到手两万两千块，还远远不够，我的时间，非常值钱。
然而凌澜这边。
飞信软件已经提醒她多次转账可能是成为了诈骗犯罪的受害者。
饶是傻子也看出有些不对劲了。
刘子文呆若木鸡，他完全确定了不是自己太菜，重新get到了道心，但这都是小问题，问题是……王庆把虚界泰斗给吊起来打？这合理吗？
12:35
又在刷新点复活的凌澜额头上都是虚汗，就算是服务器前十，都对自己没那么大的压制力，因为她刚好认识一个前十的。
大学生？
她已经把压箱底的路子都拿出来了，但仍然没有战胜此人的可能性，并且此人极为鸡贼，完全是在耍自己，位阶碾压一样的，都是假装险胜自己。
王庆现在对所谓d姐的评价可以给到介于上游和精英之间的尴尬位置，但也到此为止了。
“你哪个部队的，番号多少。”
凌澜克制住上头的情绪，目光凛冽，正色起来。
她对网友自然说的是假话，她不是什么高档社区的安全顾问，也不是地方政府的警察，而是现役天庭驻地反恐部队成员。
现在的她也不在网吧或是家里。
而是在雷州一军事基地的宿舍里。
她认为，只有这一种可能，自己都是来虚界炸鱼的，天梯榜上一大半的人都是自己这挂的。
“叔叔我啊，只是一个普通的学生。”

王庆无语，没想到这女的还自爆了，番号？猜想没错，这女的要比道上混的那些地痞专业不少，科班出生和江湖路子不是一个级别，是正规军。
“是吗……”
凌澜是不信一点，目光看向观战席上的刘子文，“他真是你同学？”
“千真万确，灰大的。”
刘子文为了圆谎，自然这样说。
“既然不是体制内的，那么你一定是……魔道中人咯。”
凌澜用戏谑的口吻，半开玩笑说道。
但所有玩笑都有认真的成分。
现在天庭对魔道的打击是完全一边倒，并且方舱公民也深刻认识到了恐怖组织对和谐社会的危害性。
魔道的生存空间很小。
但那些魔道头目，不是那么好易于的，深知重病不能下猛药。
他们现在的主要策略是渗透，把成员安置在各行各业中，碟中谍中叠。
这种策略也让他们变得更为棘手。
哪怕是曾经最狂的[联合阵线]，公然表示要消灭天庭的极端组织，近几十年也开始走上这一条路。
如此进入了恶性循环，魔道渗透得越深，天庭议会越是高压管理，越是高压管理，越是诞生更多的极端分子。
一般公民不知道。
现在方舱内酝酿着一种极度平静的爆裂，等真正炸响时，将比以前任何一次都更可怕。
“神他妈魔道中人，你要和我双修的话，那我就是魔道中人，帽子工厂都来了是吧，承认自己菜很难吗？弘扬正能量啊。”
content_en:
Although the character status can be refreshed infinitely in the virtual world, and the character controlled is always full of health and mana, human concentration is not infinite.
The player's status will naturally affect the operation.
12:34
Wang Qing repeated 10 wins and 1 loss. He must give him a chance. The twenty-two thousand yuan he has received so far is not enough. My time is very valuable.
But on Linglan's side.
Fetion software has reminded her that she may have become a victim of fraud through multiple transfers.
Even a fool can see that something is wrong.
Liu Ziwen was stunned. He was absolutely sure that he was not too incompetent and had regained the Taoist heart. But these were all small problems. The question was...Wang Qing hung up and beat the master of the virtual world? Is this reasonable?
12:35
Ling Lan, who was resurrected at the refresh point, had sweat on her forehead. Even if she was in the top ten of the server, she wouldn't have that much pressure on her because she happened to know someone who was in the top ten.
College student?
She has already tried all the ways to beat him, but there is still no possibility of defeating this person. Moreover, this person is an extremely thief, and he is completely fooling herself. He is just pretending to narrowly defeat her, even if he is crushed by rank.
Wang Qing's current evaluation of the so-called Sister D can place her in an awkward position between the upper reaches and the elite, but that's where it ends.
"Which unit do you belong to, and what is your serial number?"
Ling Lan controlled her emotions, her eyes were stern, and she became serious.
Of course, what she told netizens was a lie. She was not a security consultant in a high-end community, nor was she a local police officer, but an active member of the anti-terrorist force stationed in Tianting.
Now she is not in the Internet cafe or at home.
But in a dormitory at a military base in Leizhou.
She believed that the only possibility was that she came to the virtual world to fry fish, and that most of the people on the ladder list were her fault.
"Uncle, I am just an ordinary student."
Wang Qing was speechless. He didn't expect this woman to blow herself up. What's her number? My guess is yes, this woman is much more professional than the gangsters on the road. She was born in a major and is not on the same level as Jianghu, she is a regular soldier.
"Really..."
Ling Lan didn't believe it at all, and looked at Liu Ziwen in the audience seat, "Is he really your classmate?"
"It's absolutely true, the big gray one."
Liu Ziwen naturally said this in order to cover up his lie.
"Since you are not within the system, then you must be...a member of the devil's path."
Ling Lan said in a joking tone, half joking.
But there is an element of seriousness to all the jokes.
Now the Heavenly Court's attack on the devil is completely one-sided, and Fangcang citizens are also deeply aware of the dangers of terrorist organizations to a harmonious society.
The living space of the devil is very small.
But those demon leaders are not so easy-going. They know that serious illnesses cannot be treated with strong medicine.
Their main strategy now is infiltration, placing members in various industries.
This strategy also makes them trickier.
Even the most arrogant [United Front], an extremist organization that openly stated that it wanted to eliminate heaven, has begun to follow this path in recent decades.
This has entered a vicious cycle. The deeper the demonic path penetrates, the more high-pressure management the Heavenly Parliament adopts. The more high-pressure management the more extremists are born.
The average citizen has no idea.
Now there is an extremely quiet explosion brewing in the cabin. When it actually explodes, it will be more terrifying than any before.
"God damn it, if you want to practice dual cultivation with me, then I will be a person of the devil. Even the hat factory is here, right? Is it difficult to admit that you are not good at it? Promote positive energy."
